name: Upshift
description: Render less, see more. Upshift draws the world at a lower internal resolution and resolves it back with real upscalers - FSR 1, NVIDIA Image Scaling and a built-in temporal accumulate - and presents extra interpolated frames on any GPU, selectable at 2x, 3x or 4x. Both live inside Sodium's video settings, both work on the OpenGL and the Vulkan backend.
